versions.changelog:
- No code or SKILL.md content changes in this version.
- Maintenance release to update version number only.

- Initial release of rag-chunking-optimizer.
- Analyze document corpora and recommend optimal chunking strategies for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
- Evaluate and compare chunking methods, chunk sizes, overlap settings, and metadata enrichment.
- Includes guidance for technical, narrative, code-heavy, tabular, and legal documents.
- Offers detailed evaluation metrics and A/B testing frameworks for retrieval quality improvement.
